step_metadata.name: Technical Analysis & Gap Detection
step_metadata.description: Automated analysis for gaps, redundancies, inefficiencies, context bottlenecks

tool_usage.note: The --system-root parameter is REQUIRED when multiple working_memory.json files exist (e.g., when system_root differs from reflow_root). It tells the tool which working_memory.json to use for path resolution.

gap_detection.unreachable_functions: Functions not reachable from entry points
gap_detection.dead_end_functions: Functions with no outgoing edges (no next steps)
gap_detection.incomplete_flows: User scenarios not fully covered by function paths

redundancy_detection.unnecessary_functions: Functions not contributing to any user scenario

efficiency_analysis.high_fan_out: Functions calling too many others (potential god function)
efficiency_analysis.high_fan_in: Functions called by too many others (potential bottleneck)

context_bottleneck_analysis.when_applicable: Only for AI agent workflows with context consumption tracking
analyses: Context consumption paths (cumulative token consumption along paths)
Context bottlenecks (paths exceeding available context window)
context_bottleneck_analysis.purpose: Ensure AI agents can complete workflows within their context windows (e.g., 200k tokens)

examples: Gaps: Missing functions required for user scenarios
Unreachable functions: Functions that can never execute
Context bottlenecks: Paths exceeding available context (AI workflows)
CRITICAL.action: MUST FIX before proceeding to service allocation

next_step: FA-06 (iterative refinement to address critical issues)
